# WellSource — Health & Wellness Blog

## Overview

Build the homepage for **WellSource**, a trusted health and wellness media platform. Think WebMD meets a modern editorial blog — authoritative yet approachable. The audience is everyday consumers looking for reliable health information, so the design must immediately communicate **credibility and warmth** without feeling clinical or cold.

## Visual Direction

- **Color palette**: Use a calming, health-oriented scheme — soft teals/greens as primary, warm whites and light grays for backgrounds, with accents of coral or amber for CTAs. Avoid harsh reds or overly saturated colors.
- **Typography**: Clean, modern sans-serif (e.g., Inter, DM Sans, or similar) with strong hierarchy. Headlines should feel confident; body text should be highly readable at comfortable sizes.
- **Mood**: Professional but human. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows. The page should feel like a well-organized magazine — content-rich without being overwhelming.

## Key Priorities

1. **Trust is everything.** The credibility stats ticker and trust pillars section are critical — these must feel prominent and polished. The scrolling ticker with stats like "130 medical reviewers" and "50 million monthly readers" should be eye-catching and smooth.

2. **The mega-menu navigation** is a core interaction. Each main nav item should expand a well-structured dropdown with subcategories. This is how users discover content — make it intuitive and visually clean.

3. **Recommended Reads tabs** are the primary interactive content discovery mechanism. The tab switching between categories (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, etc.) must feel snappy and seamless, updating the article grid below without page reload.

4. **Newsletter signup** should be visually compelling — this is a key conversion goal. Make the CTA section stand out with a contrasting background.

5. **Health topics carousel** should scroll smoothly with clear navigation arrows and attractive circular image cards.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the complete section list, all interaction specs, and detailed data content.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust

## Brand
WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.

Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)

## Header Navigation
- **Health Conditions** — dropdown mega-menu with subcategories: Breast Cancer, Chronic Kidney Disease, COPD, Digestive Health, Eye Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Mental Health, Migraine, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Sleep Health, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management
- **Wellness** — dropdown with: CBD, Fitness, Healthy Aging, Hearing, Mental Well-Being, Nutrition, Parenthood, Recipes, Sexual Health, Skin Care, Sleep Health, Vitamins and Supplements, Women's Wellness; also Product Reviews and Featured Programs
- **Tools** — Pill Identifier, FindCare, Drugs A-Z, Medicare Plans by State, Lessons, Newsletters, Lifestyle Quizzes
- **Featured** — Health News, Top Reads, Video Series
- **Connect** — Bezzy community links, social media

Secondary actions: Subscribe | Sign In

## Credibility Stats
A continuously scrolling ticker bar displaying:
- Medically reviewed content
- 145 medical reviewers in network
- 21 years of experience
- 55 million monthly readers

## Hero Content
Category label: Fitness
Title: "Day 12: Resistance Band Moves You Can Do in 10 Minutes"
Subtitle: "Simple, beginner-friendly resistance band exercises to build strength and improve flexibility at home."
Visual context: 30-day fitness challenge badge

## Trending Articles
- **Heart Health** — How to Make a Heart-Healthy Grocery List
- **Wellness** — The Worst U.S. Cities for Spring Allergies in 2026, Ranked
- **Lifestyle** — Can You Run a Marathon … with POTS?
- **Products** — Is Floor Sitting the New Standing? This Unique Desk Surprised Us

## Newsletter CTA
Heading: "The best of health and wellness"
Body: "We do the research so you don't have to. Stay in the know with the latest in health and wellness."
Input: Email field
CTA: "Join Now"
Privacy note: "Your privacy is important to us."

## Health Topics
Horizontally scrollable card carousel with circular images:
- Anxiety & Depression
- Digestive Health
- Heart Health
- Menopause
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Weight Management

Action: "View all" link

## Health Tools
### Nutrition Hub
Heading: "Healthy eating, simplified"
Body: "Take charge of your nutrition with guidance on meal planning, diets, supplements, and more from our dietitians and nutritionists."
CTA: "Visit Nutrition Hub"

Tools list:
- **Recipe Hub** — Try 400+ recipes for different dietary preferences
- **Macronutrient Calculator** — Calculate your daily carb, protein, and fat goals
- **Calorie Calculator** — Learn how many calories you need for your weight goals

### Drug & Care Tools
- **Drug Directory: A to Z** — Learn everything you need to know about specific prescriptions and over-the-counter medications. CTA: "Search drugs"
- **Pill Identifier** — Identify an unknown tablet or capsule
- **GLP-1 Resource** — Compare places to buy weight-loss medications online
- **FindCare** — Find local doctors who accept your insurance

## Recommended Reads
Tabbed category filters: Top Reads | Fitness | Mental Well-Being | Product Reviews | Recipes | Skin Care

Articles displayed:
- 16 Superfoods That Are Worthy of the Title
- Does Ozempic Cause Hair Loss?
- Prescription Drug Content on Social Media Often Misleading, Study Finds
- Can Music Therapy Help with Depression?
- Why Am I Craving So Much Salt?
- These Are the 8 Best Calorie Counter Apps

## Trust Pillars
Section heading: "Why you can trust us on your health journey"

- **For you, by experts** — Experienced health writers break down complex topics so your choices feel clearer.
- **Built to move you forward** — We pair trusted information with tools and resources to guide your real health decisions.
- **Reviewed by professionals** — Content accuracy checked by our medical experts so information is always dependable.
- **Always up to date** — We regularly update our content as medical guidance evolves, so your next steps reflect what's current.

## Featured Programs
Cards linking to curated editorial programs (with "View all" link):
- Beginner's Guide to Sensitive Skin
- Living with Multiple Sclerosis
- Eczema Solutions: Knowledge for Self-Care
- Men's Wellness

## Latest Videos
Video cards with play buttons (with "View all videos" link):
- 7 Types of Exercises to Relieve Constipation
- What Every Psoriasis Patient Needs to Know About Flares and Stress
- Parkinson's Disease: 5 Progression Stages
- Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria Facts and Resources

## Footer
Newsletter signup: "Filter out the noise and nurture your inbox with health and wellness advice that's inclusive and rooted in medical expertise."
Email input + "Sign Up" button

Footer links:
- About Us · Contact Us · Privacy Policy · Privacy Settings · Advertising Policy · Health Topics · Sitemap · Medical Affairs · Content Integrity · Newsletters

Legal: "© 2026 WellSource Media LLC. All rights reserved. Our website services, content, and products are for informational purposes only. WellSource does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment."

Social: Facebook · X · Pinterest · Instagram · YouTube

{
  "application": "web-design",
  "case_id": "case-healthcare-blog-wellsource",
  "language": "en",
  "site": {
    "type": "blog",
    "page_count": 1,
    "audience": "general consumers seeking trusted health and wellness information",
    "tone": "professional, modern, warm",
    "responsive": true,
    "dark_mode": false
  },
  "brief": {
    "title": "WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust",
    "one_liner": "A comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions.",
    "goal": "Establish trust as a leading health information resource, drive newsletter signups, and guide users to explore health topics, tools, and curated content."
  },
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_id": "home",
      "file": "index.html",
      "sections": [
        "header-nav",
        "hero",
        "trending",
        "newsletter-cta",
        "health-topics",
        "tools",
        "recommended-reads",
        "trust-section",
        "featured-programs",
        "latest-videos",
        "footer"
      ],
      "objective": "Serve as the main entry point showcasing featured health content, trending articles, interactive tools, and trust signals to engage visitors and encourage exploration."
    }
  ],
  "navigation": [
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Health Conditions menu link",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Wellness menu link",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Tools menu link",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Featured menu link",
      "to": "home"
    },
    {
      "from": "home",
      "trigger": "Connect menu link",
      "to": "home"
    }
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {
      "id": "nav-dropdown",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click on main navigation menu items (Health Conditions, Wellness, Tools, etc.)",
      "expected": "Dropdown mega-menu expands showing subcategories and links",
      "type": "toggle"
    },
    {
      "id": "recommended-reads-tabs",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click on category tabs (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, Skin Care)",
      "expected": "Article grid below updates to show articles matching the selected category",
      "type": "state-change"
    },
    {
      "id": "health-topics-carousel",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Click left/right arrow buttons on health topics section",
      "expected": "Health topic cards scroll horizontally to reveal more topics",
      "type": "state-change"
    },
    {
      "id": "newsletter-signup",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Enter email and click Join Now button",
      "expected": "Email is submitted for newsletter subscription",
      "type": "input"
    },
    {
      "id": "trust-stats-ticker",
      "page": "home",
      "trigger": "Automatic scrolling ticker in the credibility bar",
      "expected": "Stats about medical reviewers, years of experience, and monthly readers scroll continuously",
      "type": "state-change"
    }
  ],
  "data_display": [
    {
      "id": "credibility-stats",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "stats",
      "source_ref": "## Credibility Stats",
      "expected_content": [
        "Medically reviewed content",
        "145 medical reviewers in network",
        "21 years of experience",
        "55 million monthly readers"
      ],
      "description": "A scrolling ticker bar displaying key trust and credibility metrics about the platform's medical review process and reach."
    },
    {
      "id": "trending-articles",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Trending Articles",
      "expected_content": [
        "How to Make a Heart-Healthy Grocery List",
        "The Worst U.S Cities for Spring Allergies in 2026, Ranked",
        "Can You Run a Marathon ... with POTS?",
        "Is Floor Sitting the New Standing? This Unique Desk Surprised Us"
      ],
      "description": "A sidebar list of trending health articles organized by category labels like Heart Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, and Products."
    },
    {
      "id": "health-topics-grid",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Health Topics",
      "expected_content": [
        "Anxiety & Depression",
        "Digestive Health",
        "Heart Health",
        "Menopause",
        "Type 2 Diabetes",
        "Weight Management"
      ],
      "description": "A horizontally scrollable grid of health topic cards with circular images and labels for browsing by condition or wellness area."
    },
    {
      "id": "tools-section",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Health Tools",
      "expected_content": [
        "Recipe Hub",
        "Macronutrient Calculator",
        "Calorie Calculator",
        "Drug Directory: A to Z",
        "Pill Identifier",
        "FindCare"
      ],
      "description": "Interactive health tools section featuring nutrition calculators, drug search, pill identifier, and doctor finder with brief descriptions."
    },
    {
      "id": "recommended-reads",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Recommended Reads",
      "expected_content": [
        "16 Superfoods That Are Worthy of the Title",
        "Does Ozempic Cause Hair Loss?",
        "Can Music Therapy Help with Depression?",
        "These Are the 8 Best Calorie Counter Apps"
      ],
      "description": "A tabbed section of recommended article cards filterable by categories like Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, and Skin Care."
    },
    {
      "id": "trust-pillars",
      "page": "home",
      "type": "list",
      "source_ref": "## Trust Pillars",
      "expected_content": [
        "For you, by experts",
        "Built to move you forward",
        "Reviewed by professionals",
        "Always up to date"
      ],
      "description": "A trust and credibility section explaining the editorial process with four key pillars: expert writers, actionable guidance, professional review, and current information."
    }
  ]
}

      transform: translateY(0);

      --green-light: #ECFDF5;
      --green: #059669;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius-md: 10px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; background: none; }
    ul, ol { list-style: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    .container { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; }

    /* ==================== HEADER ==================== */
    .header {
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--teal);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .main-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-item:hover, .nav-item.active {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .nav-item::after {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 0; height: 0;
      border-left: 4px solid transparent;
      border-right: 4px solid transparent;
      border-top: 4px solid currentColor;
      margin-left: 6px;
      vertical-align: middle;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-item.active::after { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-subscribe {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }
    .btn-signin {
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-signin:hover { background: var(--teal-light); }

    /* ==================== MEGA MENU ==================== */
    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      padding: 28px 32px;
      min-width: 600px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.25s, visibility 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .nav-item.active .mega-menu {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }
    .mega-menu-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .mega-menu-grid.cols-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .mega-menu-grid.cols-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    .mega-link {
      display: block;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .mega-link:hover { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }
    .mega-menu-footer {
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding-top: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .mega-menu-footer .mega-link {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .mega-heading {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 8px 12px 4px;
    }

    /* ==================== STATS TICKER ==================== */
    .stats-ticker {
      background: var(--teal);
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 10px 0;
    }
    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 60px;
      animation: ticker-scroll 25s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .ticker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .ticker-item .ticker-icon {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    .ticker-sep {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    @keyframes ticker-scroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ==================== HERO ==================== */
    .hero {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      padding: 48px 0;
    }
    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-content {}
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      max-width: 520px;
    }
    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .hero-cta:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .hero-image {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-image-placeholder {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .hero-image-placeholder .icon {
      font-size: 4rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .hero-challenge-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px; right: 20px;
      background: var(--coral);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    /* ==================== TRENDING ==================== */
    .trending {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }
    .section-link {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .section-link:hover { gap: 8px; }
    .trending-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .trending-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .trending-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .trending-card-img {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .trending-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }
    .trending-card-tag {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .trending-card-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    /* ==================== NEWSLETTER CTA ==================== */
    .newsletter-cta {
      padding: 64px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--teal-dark) 100%);
    }
    .newsletter-inner {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .newsletter-heading {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }
    .newsletter-body {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      max-width: 440px;
      margin: 0 auto 12px;
    }
    .newsletter-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-family: inherit;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    }
    .newsletter-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }
    .newsletter-input:focus { border-color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .newsletter-btn {
      background: var(--coral);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .newsletter-btn:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .newsletter-privacy {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    /* ==================== HEALTH TOPICS ==================== */
    .health-topics {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }
    .topics-carousel-wrap {
      position: relative;
    }
    .topics-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      padding: 8px 4px 16px;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .topics-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .topic-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      width: 140px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .topic-circle {
      width: 110px; height: 110px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.4rem;
      transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
      border: 3px solid transparent;
    }
    .topic-card:hover .topic-circle {
      transform: scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }
    .topic-label {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }
    .carousel-arrow {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      z-index: 5;
      transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }
    .carousel-arrow:hover { background: var(--teal-light); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
    .carousel-arrow.left { left: -12px; }
    .carousel-arrow.right { right: -12px; }

    /* ==================== HEALTH TOOLS ==================== */
    .health-tools {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .tool-section {
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s;
    }
    .tool-section:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .tool-section-header { margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .tool-section-title {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .tool-section-desc {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .tool-section-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 14px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .tool-section-cta:hover { gap: 10px; }
    .tool-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .tool-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .tool-item:hover { background: var(--teal-50); }
    .tool-icon {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .tool-info { flex: 1; }
    .tool-name {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .tool-desc {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .tool-cta-sm {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }

    /* ==================== RECOMMENDED READS ==================== */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }
    .reads-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .reads-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .reads-tab {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .reads-tab:hover { color: var(--teal); border-color: var(--teal); }
    .reads-tab.active {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }
    .reads-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .read-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .read-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .read-card-img {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--gray-300);
    }
    .read-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }
    .read-card-tag {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .read-card-title {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .read-card-meta {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    /* ==================== TRUST PILLARS ==================== */
    .trust-section {
      padding: 64px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .trust-heading {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .trust-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .trust-card {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 28px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .trust-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .trust-icon {
      width: 56px; height: 56px;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    .trust-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .trust-desc {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ==================== FEATURED PROGRAMS ==================== */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }
    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .program-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .program-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .program-card-img {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.2rem;
    }
    .program-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 20px; }
    .program-card-title {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ==================== LATEST VIDEOS ==================== */
    .latest-videos {
      padding: 56px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .videos-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .video-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
    }
    .video-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .video-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--charcoal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .play-btn {
      width: 52px; height: 52px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    }
    .play-btn::after {
      content: '';
      display: block;
      width: 0; height: 0;
      border-top: 10px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 10px solid transparent;
      border-left: 16px solid var(--teal);
      margin-left: 3px;
